name: Do I need to pay real estate agent commissions if I sell for cash?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to pay real estate agent commissions if I sell for cash?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selling your house for cash to an investor, you typically do not pay real estate agent commissions. This is a significant advantage as it can save you 5-6% of the sale price. With Kelby Contreras, an agent at Realty ONE Group Evolution, you can explore options that may involve a direct cash buyer, where the buyer covers their own agent fees or operates without one, resulting in no commission cost to you. This is a practical tradeoff: you forego the broader market exposure of a traditional listing but save on commission expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, if you sell your house directly to a cash investor, you typically avoid real estate agent commissions, saving you a percentage of the sale price.
